sections.query:
select *  from 
(
select  at.server , at.session_id , at.program_name ,  at.start_time , at.command , at.object_name , at.database_name , at.last_request_end_time   , at.query , at.login_name from 
 monitoring.active_transactions at 
where last_request_end_time > $__timeFrom() 
)
